title: Introduction to Simple Machines
text: A young scientist demonstrates how a lever works by lifting a heavy rock. She places a long wooden board on a small stone to create a simple lever. The scientist pushes down on one end of the lever to lift the heavy rock on the other end. Next, she shows how a pulley works by hanging a rope over a wheel. The scientist pulls down on the rope to lift a bucket of water upward. She explains how pulleys make work easier by changing the direction of force.
